sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate faithfully encodes the IA/IA Super applicability, LIWL input, mutually exclusive practicability alternatives, ice-knife extension check, and equivalent-means alternative. Canonical owners, datatypes, controlled ice-class values, and the required iceClassValue class constraint are correctly represented.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: The candidate omits the declared required input LIWL. Add nltl:lowerIceWaterline on the ship with its canonical xsd:string datatype and enforce its presence for the applicable IA/IA Super cases (or otherwise encode the supplied LIWL input explicitly alongside the extension check). Preserve the existing explicit boolean branch selection and alternative protection checks.
